page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 6 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core tests scoring in the bottom 10% to 25%. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by the Passmark CPU score and Geekbench multi-core benchmarks. Memory bandwidth tests for both cached and uncached reads and writes fall within the middle 50% tier, though the overall Passmark memory score is positioned in the bottom 25%.

Given its hardware profile, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high single-threaded CPU performance or local storage. It is suitable for database operations, as evidenced by average Redis SET performance of 8.48 million operations per second, as well as memory-cached applications, enterprise middleware, and moderate multi-threaded processing tasks.
